title: Neural Contrastive Clustering: Fully Unsupervised Bias Reduction for Sentiment Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the accuracy of sentiment classifiers on a subset of hand-annotated 'bias-prone' sentences from COVID-19 Reddit discussions to determine if the models incorrectly classify them as expressing anger due to the presence of controversial topic words (e.g., 'hydroxychloroquine' or 'mandate').
